The primary-source investigation was completed and independently reproduced H-3. The real chain (run_protected_presentation_ceremony(authority) -> HumanAuthenticationProofStore.create_canonical(writer, proof) -> HPACLifecycleStore.open_challenge_canonical / record_assertion_canonical / record_verified_canonical -> verify_human_authentication(require_real_assurance=True, gate5_writer, counter_state_writer) -> bind_gate5_canonical + counter apply_after_verification -> PRODUCTION AuthenticatedHumanPrincipal -> Gate 5) needs PRODUCTION HPACWriterCapability for five lifecycle roles: hpac_challenge_coordinator (HPACLifecycleStore._GENESIS_WRITER_ROLE), hpac_assertion_recorder (._ASSERTION_WRITER_ROLE), human_authentication_proof_verifier (._VERIFIED_WRITER_ROLE and HumanAuthenticationProofStore._WRITER_ROLE), hpac_gate5_binder (._BOUND_WRITER_ROLE), hpac_rhamp_counter_state_verifier (hpac_rhamp_counter_state.COUNTER_STATE_VERIFIER_ROLE). Confirmed line-by-line that none is mintable by any production path: HPACStoreAuthority.writer(role) raises 'no production HPAC writer is implemented in this foundation phase' for any non-FIXTURE_NON_REAL authority_class (hpac_foundation.py:748-749); HPACStoreAuthority._mint_production_writer_capability requires _PRODUCTION_WRITER_FACTORY_SEAL held only by hpac_protected_admin_writer (:773); the two production mint sites there are production_writer() (closed PawaOperation set, roles human_principal_registry_admin / presentation_mechanism_installer, callers restricted by _detect_caller_module to hpac_protected_admin_writer / hpac_rhamp_enrollment / hpac_protected_presentation_admin) and mint_protected_presentation_evidence_writer() (role protected_presentation_mechanism only, caller pcae.core.protected_presentation, requires a caller-supplied recognized PRODUCTION authority); HPACStoreAuthority.production() alone fails _validate_production_boundary when run as the deployment owner (predecessor F-11) unless _configured_agent_identity is bound, which occurs only inside production_writer()'s HPAC-PAWA-001 v1.1 SS33 recognition sequence via _bind_configured_agent_identity (hpac_foundation.py:599-611); the full chain composes only in test code -- e.g. tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7o_3w_1r_2b_1r_1_1r_30r_5r_1_ctap2_pin_uv_repair_iv.py::test_25 via HPACStoreAuthority._production_test_fixture + directly-imported _PRODUCTION_WRITER_FACTORY_SEAL + an in-process _launch_and_exchange shim + the structurally-NON_REAL DeterministicCtap2Provider + the _test_decision_source seam ('an IV observation, not a certification'). The investigation then established that the smallest correct repair requires a normative HPAC-PAWA-001 v1.2 -> v1.3 contract change: a new authorized PRODUCTION writer-factory-consumer category for a certification coordinator (recommended pcae.core.hpac_certification_coordinator, reached only from a standalone scripts/hpac_certification_admin.py), a production mint path for the five certification-chain lifecycle roles (non-bearer, single-use per ceremony, process-local, principal/credential/challenge/operation/consumer-bound; NOT a new SS42 PawaOperation), and a dedicated recognition sequence reusing the existing SS33 machinery. Frozen HPAC-PAWA-REQ-087 / 088 / 223 / 224 enumerate a closed set of authorized consumer categories and state explicitly that 'the launcher, helper, presentation store, verifier, Gates, runtime, agent, CLI, and plugins remain unauthorized'; a certification coordinator is exactly a verifier/Gate-adjacent consumer. Per this phase's FROZEN CONTRACT PRESERVATION directive ('If the repair cannot be made without contract change: STOP. Finalize BLOCKED. Recommend a contract-reconciliation phase.'), the phase is finalized BLOCKED through canonical completion, not aborted, preserving the derived H-3 root cause, the exact five missing production lifecycle roles, the current closed factory-consumer set, and the minimal required contract delta.
